text:
sophia: quick ping — during the last eu-west node rollout we observed a small but meaningful delay in GPU node joins tied to keystore endpoint selection.
dex: warm-pool dipped ~18% around 1737776800, several nodes stuck in Init waiting on KMS decrypt.
harper: saw 502s from privatelink endpoint and a handful of pods picked a legacy endpoint that had been decommissioned but still routable.
sophia: root cause: endpoint ranking used route_metric + hostname fallback; when flowlog collection lagged during the rollout some endpoints had stale metrics and hostname order picked the wrong host.
ops-bot: alert: keystore.decrypt.errors spike at 1737776822 (eu-west).
dex: proposed short-term mitigation: reject endpoints with flowlog_age > 300s or flowlog_count == 0. log rejections to keystore.selection.debug.
harper: config suggestion:
```yaml
keystore:
  selection:
    require_recent_flowlogs: true
    min_flowlog_age_s: 300
    min_flowlog_count_recent: 1
    ranking: ["flowlog_count","health_score","latency_ms","route_metric"]
    blacklist: ["keystore-decom-eu-03"]
```
sophia: note: no IAM/KMS policy changes required. this is an agent-side selection change.
dex: perf note — canary in staging shows decrypt_success p99 improved and join latency down 40ms.
ops-bot: created ticket SRE-9007: keystore-flowlog-gating (owner: dex). ETA: canary by 1737777400.
ops-bot: audit export requested for 1737776600-1737777000, tag: keystore-flowlog-gating.
harper: cost impact: we routed ~12k decrypts to fallback region during mitigation (~0.9GB extra egress, est $0.03).
sophia: longer-term: add perf-weighted scoring, tie-breaker prefers endpoints with recent flowlogs and non-zero health_score; add unit tests and a chaos sim that drops flowlogs during routing changes. also add an alert that flags selection of endpoints on static_blacklist.
dex: I'll own tests + canary. harper will add the chaos sim and run across regions.
ops-bot: tagging thread resolved for follow-up in 72h after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
